answers.explanation: The confirmed API registration is POST /repos/{username}/{reponame}/issues, formed by the nested groups /repos, /{username}/{reponame}, and /issues. Before repo.CreateIssue, the registered chain is reqToken(), mustNotBeArchived, bind(api.CreateIssueOption{}), and reqRepoReader(unit.TypeIssues), in that order. reqToken permits continuation only when ctx.IsSigned is true; otherwise it emits HTTP 401 "token is required". Its source comment says the general Contexter middleware already checks the token during sign-in processing, but that upstream implementation was not traced here. reqRepoReader permits continuation when the resolved repository permission can read the issues unit, or when the caller is a repository administrator or site administrator; otherwise it emits HTTP 403. The implementation of repository assignment/loading, token scopes, mustNotBeArchived, and middleware short-circuit mechanics was not fully traced, so the route is confirmed as authentication-required but the entire upstream route context is not closed.
